tool.name: gapseq adapt
tool.command: ln -s '$model' input.RDS && gapseq adapt --model input.RDS #if $id != "": --id '$id' #end if --rxn.blast.file '$b' #if $add != "": --add '$add' #end if #if $remove != "": --remove '$remove' #end if #if $growth != "": --growth '$growth' #end if #if $k != 0.0: --min.growth $k #end if --output.dir ./output/

param.label: Model identifier when the provided model RDS file is a list of many models

validator.message: Model identifiers may only consist of letters, digits, underscores, dots and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit (e.g. iML1515 or 1769349.4). Leave empty if the RDS file contains a single model.

param.label: Comma-separated list of reactions or pathways that should be added to the model

validator.message: Expected comma-separated reaction or pathway identifiers, e.g. rxn00814, R01098, 1.1.1.1 or NAPHTHALENE-12-DIOXYGENASE-RXN (letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens only)

param.label: Comma-separated list of reactions or pathways that should be removed from the model

validator.message: Expected comma-separated reaction or pathway identifiers, e.g. rxn00814, R01098, 1.1.1.1 or NAPHTHALENE-12-DIOXYGENASE-RXN (letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens only)

param.label: Compounds for which growth or non-growth should be ensured

validator.message: Expected comma-separated entries of the form cpdXXXXX:TRUE or cpdXXXXX:FALSE, e.g. cpd00027:TRUE,cpd00017:FALSE

param.label: Set minimum growth rate that should be achieved by gap-filling
